paper1_definition: Exclude any admission also coded ICD-9 800-804/850-854 or ICD-10 S06* in ANY diagnosis position
eicu_source: diagnosis.diagnosisstring 'neurologic|trauma - CNS' branch; plus 22 enumerated apacheadmissiondx head/face-trauma values; plus the traumatic-SAH path inside the stroke branch
harmonization_decision: Three sources, all enumerated. The critical one: '...|hemorrhagic stroke|subarachnoid hemorrhage|traumatic' (48 stays) sits INSIDE the stroke branch, so a prefix match on the stroke path admits it and the trauma-branch exclusion never sees it. The APACHE list is enumerated rather than regex-matched on 'trauma', which would catch cross-reference notes ('...for trauma see Trauma') and limb/chest/abdominal injuries Paper 1 never excluded. Removes 379 stays.
risk: DEVIATION: 34 stroke stays are excluded on a non-intracranial (mostly spinal) CNS-trauma path, which Paper 1's ICD list would not have caught. Quantified and reported.

paper1_definition: age at admission >=18; ages >89 capped at 90 for analysis
harmonization_decision: Cast numeric, map '> 89' to 90. This coincidentally matches Paper 1's age-capping rule, so the two age variables are comparable without further adjustment.

paper1_definition: First ICU stay of the qualifying stroke admission, one stay per patient
eicu_source: patient.unitvisitnumber = 1 within patienthealthsystemstayid; patients deduplicated on uniquepid
harmonization_decision: unitvisitnumber=1 reproduces 'first ICU stay of the admission' directly. For a patient with more than one qualifying hospital stay, eICU's de-identification removes real dates (only hospitaldischargeyear survives), so admissions cannot be ordered in time. DEVIATION, to be stated in Methods: keep the earliest hospitaldischargeyear and break ties on the lowest patienthealthsystemstayid.
risk: A forced deviation from Paper 1, but it affects only the small number of patients with repeat stroke admissions.

paper1_definition: Windows of 6 h measured from ICU intime; windows 0-11 (first 72 h); a window is materialised only while the patient is still in the ICU
eicu_source: All eICU offsets are minutes from unit admission, so window_idx = floor(offset/360), kept where 0<=window_idx<=11
harmonization_decision: This is the cleanest part of the whole mapping -- eICU's offset design gives the Paper 1 windowing for free. obs_end = min(4320, unitdischargeoffset) minutes; max_valid_window = floor(obs_end/360) clipped at 11. Negative offsets (pre-ICU labs) are dropped, exactly as Paper 1 dropped window_idx<0.
risk: None. Note that eICU offsets are relative to UNIT admission, which is the correct analogue of ICU intime.

paper1_definition: Death between ICU intime and outtime
harmonization_decision: Direct equivalent and cleaner than the MIMIC construction.

paper1_definition: Date of death used for longer-horizon outcome analysis
harmonization_decision: Cannot be replicated. Aim-1/2/3 outcome gradients in eICU are restricted to ICU and hospital mortality. State this as a limitation up front rather than substituting a different outcome.
risk: Any Paper 1 result that depends on post-discharge death is out of scope for Paper 2.

paper1_definition: Not applicable -- MIMIC-IV is a single centre
harmonization_decision: These are the substrate for Aim 3 and have no Paper 1 counterpart. They are what lets Paper 2 be a generalizability study rather than a second validation.
risk: hospitalid is present on patient; region and teaching status have missing values at some sites.

paper1_definition: Charlson comorbidity index computed from ICD codes
eicu_source: apachePatientResult.apachescore / predictedicumortality; diagnosis.icd9code for a Charlson recomputation
harmonization_decision: Recompute Charlson from eICU icd9code for Table 1 comparability. APACHE IV score is reported alongside as an eICU-native severity anchor, but is NOT used in any model.
risk: eICU ICD coding depth is shallower than MIMIC's, so Charlson will be systematically lower. Do not interpret a lower eICU Charlson as a healthier cohort without checking coding depth.

paper1_definition: Not applicable - MIMIC codes every admission
harmonization_decision: 2,006 stays that apacheadmissiondx calls stroke carry no stroke diagnosisstring; 18% of them have NO diagnosis row at all, and the misses concentrate in a few hospitals (195, 178, 121 stays at the top three). This is interface-level structural missingness, not clinical difference. Pre-specified: (a) whether a hospital populates the diagnosis table becomes a hospital eligibility criterion in the step-4 audit; (b) a sensitivity phenotype unioning the string path with apacheadmissiondx is added.
risk: Left unhandled this would silently drop whole hospitals from the cohort and confound Aim 3, since the missingness is hospital-structured rather than patient-random.
